requiredFindings.title: Declaration grouping counts expanded-definition subsets twice
requiredFindings.description: Walk::add increments the base kind for every site and also increments kind.expanded for an expanded site. The declares@syntactic prefix def. matches both counters, so the audit sums an expanded definition twice. The raw by-kind observations are correctly separated, but the firstPartySitesOfferedByRelation, dependencyCrateSitesOfferedByRelation and firstPartyPerCoveredSubjectDistribution declaration aggregates are not definition-site counts.
evidence: Axum ordinal 2: base first-party def.* counters excluding .expanded total 3268; expanded-subset counters total 2411; the audit reports 5679 declaration sites.
Hyper ordinal 3: base 759 plus expanded subset 102 becomes the reported 861.
napi ordinal 0: base 69 plus expanded subset 2 becomes the reported 71; Tokio ordinal 6: base 3 plus subset 2 becomes 5.
The dependency aggregates also add the subset twice, for example napi dependencies: 54433 base definitions plus 17777 expanded annotations become 72210 reported declaration sites.
The permitted audit reproduces the frozen JSON byte-for-byte, confirming reproducibility of the faulty aggregation rather than its semantic correctness.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Exclude .expanded annotation keys from base relation totals and per-covered-subject distributions, or publish base and expanded-subset totals separately with explicit subset semantics. Preserve raw per-kind/event data, first-party/dependency separation and all incomplete-coverage labels. Regenerate the audit output and matching frozen pins; reproduce it byte-for-byte. No compiler/driver/corpus rerun is needed to correct this derived aggregation.

nonBlockingObservations.location: REPORT.md:15, use and extern crate items, with resolution; producer/site_walk.rs:90-94
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The walk records resolution observations for use items via path.res.present_items(), but externCrate records only the item count. The report wording can be read as claiming resolution observations for both.
nonBlockingObservations.recommendation: Clarify that use items have the recorded resolution categories and extern crate items supply a count only.
nonBlockingObservations.nonBlockingReason: The raw keys and source distinguish those observations, and no candidate, semantic completeness or emitted-fact claim is made.
